questions: Do you have pain in your abdomen or groin area?
Have you noticed a swelling or lump in your abdomen or groin?
Does the swelling or lump get worse when you cough, sneeze, or lift heavy objects?
Is this a new problem (started recently) or have you had it for a while?
Do you have a fever, or does the area feel hot, red, or swollen (like an infection)?
Have you had any recent surgery or injury to your abdomen or groin?
Are you taking any medications that make you bleed more easily (like blood thinners)?
Do you have trouble with bowel movements (constipation) or urination (difficulty going)?
Have you lost weight or had less appetite than usual?
Is there any family history of hernias or similar abdominal problems?
